mission: Create a high-performance, Swiss-style inventory dashboard that prioritizes data density, clarity, and precision over decoration.

theme.name: Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast
theme.description: A utilitarian, high-contrast interface designed for rapid data scanning and decision making. Minimalist but dense.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and major section dividers. Tracking tight.

body.usage: Use for general text, labels, and descriptions. Excellent readability at small sizes.

data.usage: MANDATORY for all numerical data, tabular values, and inventory codes. Ensures vertical alignment.

dashboard_grid.name: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density)
dashboard_grid.rules: Maximize screen real estate. Use col-span-X to define widget importance. No jagged bottoms.

cards.classes: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:border-zinc-300 transition-colors

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-50 hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-red-50 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-100 border border-red-100 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

inputs.base: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.header: bg-zinc-50 border-b border-zinc-200 text-zinc-500 font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

login_background.usage: Use as a full-screen background for the login page with a dark overlay (bg-black/40) to ensure text readability.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px depending on size. Keep consistent.
icons.usage: Use specific icons for actions (e.g., 'Plus' for add, 'Trash2' for delete, 'BarChart3' for analytics).

charts.style: Minimalist. Remove grid lines if possible, or make them very subtle. Use tooltips for data details.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 against background.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds, stick to solid colors or subtle patterns.
Every interactive element must have a 'data-testid' attribute.
All forms must use 'react-hook-form' with 'zod' validation.
Prioritize data density in tables - avoid excessive padding that wastes space.
Dashboards should be composed of 'Widgets' (Cards) that fit into the grid.
Inventory calculations (Initial + Moves - Sales = Theoretical) must be accurate and highlighted.
